items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: he got my mother to give him permission to do an experimental operation on me... That doctor's name today is Dr. Michael DeBakey.

ctx.x: Just going back through my list here, how did you get the nickname Half Ahead?

Well, that's something I was just mentioning about when I was 11 years old and I was playing baseball on the altar boys team. I was an altar boy for Corpus Christi. One day we were playing ball and a baseball hit me in the side of my head causing a tumor, a sebaceous cyst. And it was extracted, analyzed, and found out to be cancer. I was 11 years old. This was 51 years ago. No, 52 years, 53 years now. I'm back. Anyhow, at this time I was put in the hospital and like I said, he extracted the tumor and he took it…
Yeah. He was here in New Orleans? Yes.
